policy: Public records are source-linked and dated. Adopted requirements are separated from proposals and scheduled future actions; no proposed zoning/noise rule or tentative moratorium vote is represented as adopted.

records.value: All new data centers in Fort Worth Water Utility service area must use closed-loop cooling systems
All new data centers in Fort Worth Water Utility service area must obtain a Non-Significant Industrial User pretreatment permit
NSIU permit may require chemical disclosure and Safety Data Sheets
NSIU permit may require spill prevention, slug control and secondary containment
NSIU permit may require monitoring and inspection access, discharge limitations, annual certification, training, reporting and emergency notification
Required studies determine system impacts, needed improvements and permit requirements
Study identifies demand, system impact, off-site improvements, and meter/tap size
Developer pays full cost of extending off-site water infrastructure; City may contribute for oversizing
Water/wastewater impact fees are meter-size based; connection charges include a Council-adopted per-MGD water-allocation charge
Report/recommendations due Nov. 3, 2026; presentation scheduled Nov. 10, 2026; scheduled/due is not completed
Process initiated Aug. 11; first hearing due no later than Nov. 10; tentative adoption vote Feb. 16, 2027; moratorium not represented as adopted
June 2026 data-center-specific zoning and noise standards remain proposed, not adopted
